name: Naqash Naseeb Bhatti
availability: Based in Islamabad, Pakistan | Working remotely with Canadian businesses
intro: I help hotels, colleges and real estate teams turn their ideas into content people actually see. I make the plan, brief the creative team, keep track of the details and help get each campaign out on time.
about: I'm Naqash, a digital campaign and content strategist based in Islamabad, Pakistan. I plan social content, write briefs for designers and video editors, organize approvals and publishing, and work with advertising specialists to get campaigns ready to launch. I enjoy turning a busy brief into a simple plan everyone can follow. I also work remotely with businesses and creative teams in Canada.
